title: Not to Us, O Lord, Not to Us

questions.question: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name give what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:1 (ESV): "Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory,"

questions.question: For the sake of your steadfast love and your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:1 (ESV): "for the sake of your steadfast love and your faithfulness!"

questions.question: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Our God is in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:3 (ESV): "Our God is in the heavens; he does all that he pleases."

questions.question: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:4 (ESV): "Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands."

questions.question: They have mouths, but do not speak; eyes, but do not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:5 (ESV): "They have mouths, but do not speak; eyes, but do not see."

questions.question: They have ears, but do not hear; noses, but do not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:6 (ESV): "They have ears, but do not hear; noses, but do not smell."

questions.question: They have hands, but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; and they do not make a sound in their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:7 (ESV): "...and they do not make a sound in their throat."

questions.question: Those who make them become like them; so do all who trust in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:8 (ESV): "Those who make them become like them; so do all who trust in them."

questions.question: O Israel, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:9 (ESV): "O Israel, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their shield."

questions.question: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:10 (ESV): "O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their shield."

questions.question: You who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their shield. The Lord has remembered us; he will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:12 (ESV): "The Lord has remembered us; he will bless us;"

questions.question: He will bless those who fear the Lord, both the small and the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:13 (ESV): "he will bless those who fear the Lord, both the small and the great."

questions.question: May the Lord give you increase, you and your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:14 (ESV): "May the Lord give you increase, you and your children!"

questions.question: The heavens are the Lord's heavens, but the earth he has given to the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:16 (ESV): "...but the earth he has given to the children of man."

questions.question: The dead do not praise the Lord, nor do any who go down into what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 115:17 (ESV): "The dead do not praise the Lord, nor do any who go down into silence."

key_verse_text: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love and your faithfulness!
